name: London, United Kingdom — partial solar eclipse
source_notes: The published local timetable lists London first contact 10:09, maximum 10:59 and end 11:51 BST. Times are converted to UTC (BST=UTC+01:00 on 2022-10-25). Coordinates are approximate London city-centre coordinates, not a survey station. NASA's GSFC Solar Eclipse Search Engine independently identifies 2022-10-25 as a partial eclipse and gives greatest eclipse at 11:00:07 UT; see https://eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov/SEsearch/SEdata.php?Ecl=+20221025.
